result.summary: Found 2 visible issues: a nonsensical discount badge and a truncated restaurant name in a horizontal card.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows a discount badge reading '−0%', which is meaningless and looks broken.
issues.suggestion: Replace the badge with the actual discount (e.g., '−20%') or remove it entirely if no discount applies.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Use CSS ellipsis for text overflow or slightly widen the cards so the full name fits.
